data.name: Dungeons of Dreadmoor
data.detailed_description:
"Hello dear Adventurer… this is the map to the Dungeons of Dreadmoor. Great riches await the most fearless of warriors. But beware! Great terror and quick death also inhabit these dungeons, ready to dispatch the unprepared! Do you have the courage and skill to claim the treasure of Velthemor the Dragon?"

Explore an Ever-Changing Dungeon

  • Every playthrough generates a brand-new dungeon layout. No two runs are ever the same

  • Three difficulty levels adjust dungeon size, from a tight 8-room crawl to a sprawling 15-room gauntlet

  • Descend through four distinct dungeon levels, each with its own color-coded atmosphere. Finally culminating in a fiery confrontation with the dragon Velthemor.

Arm Yourself

  • Fire standard arrows or switch to devastating magic arrows for heavy damage

  • Manage a limited quiver. Scavenge, loot, and fight smart to keep your arsenal stocked

Loot, Risk, and Reward

  • Collect gold, keys, and treasure from chests scattered throughout the dungeon

  • Rare locked chests and master chests offer high-value rewards for those willing to explore

  • Find healing fonts to trade your gold for a second wind mid-run

Retro Presentation, Modern Feel

  • Authentic 1980s Intellivision-inspired pixel art and chiptune-style sound design

  • Full controller support alongside keyboard and mouse

    Note: This game is for use on PC or Mac. The above image is a throwback to older video game accessories. 

_______________________


This is a game that i've always wanted to make. As a kid, i played the Atari 2600, the Mattel Electronics Intellivision and the ColecoVision. 20 years or so i had a dream where i played this game and I had a great time. I got up and made the graphic that you see in the first part of this game. 



This game was made to play exactly like those old games. This is as true to the 16-bit gameplay from them as i could get. I didn't want to add modern elements. This is an exercise in pure retro gaming. 



This is also my first game released on Steam. I have made mobile games and VR experiences in the past, but this is my first release by myself. If there are bugs or gameplay suggestions feel free to leave me a message and i'll update. Thnanks for checking this out and have a good day.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7/10
  • Processor: Any basic dual-core processor from the last 15 years (supporting SSE2)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.3-capable GPU (Compatibility Renderer)
  • Storage: 106 MB available space

  • Storage: 106 MB available space

  • Processor: Intel 64-bit (x86_64) or Apple Silicon (ARM64)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated or dedicated GPU with full OpenGL 3.3 support
  • Storage: 74 MB available space
